SECTION 1: SPEC BULLET ANALYSIS

✅ * Select electrons with pT > 25 GeV and |eta| < 2.5; computed as: [e for e in electrons if e['pt'] > 25 and abs(e['eta']) < 2.5]; upstream chain: selected_electrons; 〔L293-L294〕
✅ * Select muons with pT > 25 GeV and |eta| < 2.4; computed as: [m for m in muons if m['pt'] > 25 and abs(m['eta']) < 2.4]; upstream chain: selected_muons; 〔L294-L295〕
✅ * Require exactly one lepton (electron or muon); computed as: if len(selected_leptons) != 1: continue; upstream chain: selected_leptons; 〔L297-L298〕
✅ * Require at least 4 jets with pT > 30 GeV and |eta| < 2.5; computed as: [j for j in jets if j['pt'] > 30 and abs(j['eta']) < 2.5]; upstream chain: selected_jets; 〔L303-L304〕
✅ * Require at least 2 b-tagged jets; computed as: [b for b in bjets if b['pt'] > 30 and abs(b['eta']) < 2.5]; upstream chain: selected_bjets; 〔L310-L311〕
✅ * Select MET > 20 GeV; computed as: if met is None or met['pt'] < 20: continue; upstream chain: met; 〔L316-L318〕
✅ * Select transverse mass of the lepton and MET between 30 and 150 GeV (W candidate); computed as: if mt < 30 or mt > 150: continue; upstream chain: mt; 〔L324-L325〕
✅ * Build the hadronic W candidate from the two leading non-b-tagged jets; computed as: sum_objects(leading_light_jet, subleading_light_jet); upstream chain: leading_light_jet, subleading_light_jet; 〔L340-L341〕
✅ * Select the hadronic W mass between 40 to 120GeV; computed as: if w_hadronic_mass < 40 or w_hadronic_mass > 120: continue; upstream chain: w_hadronic_mass; 〔L343-L344〕
✅ * Build the hadronic top candidate from the leading b-jet and the hadronic W candidate; computed as: sum_objects(leading_bjet, w_hadronic); upstream chain: leading_bjet, w_hadronic; 〔L351-L352〕

✅ * Plot the transverse mass of lepton + MET (W leptonic candidate); computed as: mt_list; upstream chain: mt; 〔L328-L329〕
✅ * Plot the MET distribution; computed as: met_list; upstream chain: met['pt']; 〔L329-L330〕
✅ * Plot the pT of the leading b-jet; computed as: leading_bjet_pt_list; upstream chain: leading_bjet['pt']; 〔L375-L376〕
✅ * Plot the pT of the subleading b-jet; computed as: subleading_bjet_pt_list; upstream chain: subleading_bjet['pt']; 〔L379-L381〕
✅ * Plot the invariant mass of the two leading non-b-tagged jets (W hadronic candidate) in range 40 to 120 GeV; computed as: w_hadronic_mass_list; upstream chain: w_hadronic_mass; 〔L346-L347〕
✅ * Plot the invariant mass of leading b-jet + W hadronic candidate (top hadronic) in range 100 to 250 GeV; computed as: top_mass_list; upstream chain: top_mass; 〔L358-L359〕
✅ * Plot delta R between the leading lepton and the closest b-jet; computed as: dr_lepton_bjet_list; upstream chain: min_dr; 〔L360-L366〕
✅ * Plot the HT distribution (scalar sum of all jet pT); computed as: ht_list; upstream chain: scalar_pt_sum(selected_jets); 〔L368-L370〕
✅ * Plot the number of jets per event; computed as: njet_list; upstream chain: len(selected_jets); 〔L372-L373〕
✅ * Plot eta of the leading b-jet; computed as: leading_bjet_eta_list; upstream chain: leading_bjet['eta']; 〔L385-L386〕

SECTION 2: DEFINITION SUMMARY

* [CHECK CAREFULLY] DEFINITION SUMMARY

* selected_electrons
  - computed/defined as: [e for e in electrons if e['pt'] > 25 and abs(e['eta']) < 2.5]
  - upstream chain: electrons -> get_electrons(event)
  - collection definition: e['pt'] > 25 and abs(e['eta']) < 2.5
  - structure: single-constituent

* selected_muons
  - computed/defined as: [m for m in muons if m['pt'] > 25 and abs(m['eta']) < 2.4]
  - upstream chain: muons -> get_muons(event)
  - collection definition: m['pt'] > 25 and abs(m['eta']) < 2.4
  - structure: single-constituent

* selected_leptons
  - computed/defined as: selected_electrons + selected_muons
  - upstream chain: selected_electrons, selected_muons
  - collection definition: electrons and muons with pT > 25 and |eta| < 2.5 or 2.4
  - structure: multi-input

* selected_jets
  - computed/defined as: [j for j in jets if j['pt'] > 30 and abs(j['eta']) < 2.5]
  - upstream chain: jets -> get_jets(event)
  - collection definition: j['pt'] > 30 and abs(j['eta']) < 2.5
  - structure: single-constituent

* selected_bjets
  - computed/defined as: [b for b in bjets if b['pt'] > 30 and abs(b['eta']) < 2.5]
  - upstream chain: bjets -> get_bjets(event)
  - collection definition: b['pt'] > 30 and abs(b['eta']) < 2.5
  - structure: single-constituent

* met
  - computed/defined as: helper_get_met(event)
  - upstream chain: event['objects']
  - collection definition: object with type == 6
  - structure: single-constituent

* mt
  - computed/defined as: helper_transverse_mass(lepton, met)
  - upstream chain: lepton -> selected_leptons[0], met
  - collection definition: transverse mass of lepton and MET
  - structure: composite-derived

* w_hadronic
  - computed/defined as: sum_objects(leading_light_jet, subleading_light_jet)
  - upstream chain: leading_light_jet -> helper_get_leading(selected_light_jets), subleading_light_jet -> helper_get_subleading(selected_light_jets)
  - collection definition: two leading non-b-tagged jets
  - structure: composite-derived

* w_hadronic_mass
  - computed/defined as: w_hadronic['mass']
  - upstream chain: w_hadronic
  - collection definition: invariant mass of two leading non-b-tagged jets
  - structure: single-constituent

* top_candidate
  - computed/defined as: sum_objects(leading_bjet, w_hadronic)
  - upstream chain: leading_bjet -> helper_get_leading(selected_bjets), w_hadronic
  - collection definition: leading b-jet and hadronic W candidate
  - structure: composite-derived

* top_mass
  - computed/defined as: top_candidate['mass']
  - upstream chain: top_candidate
  - collection definition: invariant mass of leading b-jet and hadronic W candidate
  - structure: single-constituent

* min_dr
  - computed/defined as: min of helper_delta_r(lepton, bjet) for all bjet in selected_bjets
  - upstream chain: lepton -> selected_leptons[0], selected_bjets
  - collection definition: minimum ΔR between lepton and b-jet
  - structure: composite-derived

* ht
  - computed/defined as: scalar_pt_sum(selected_jets)
  - upstream chain: selected_jets
  - collection definition: scalar sum of jet pT
  - structure: single-constituent

* njet
  - computed/defined as: len(selected_jets)
  - upstream chain: selected_jets
  - collection definition: number of jets
  - structure: single-constituent

* leading_bjet_pt
  - computed/defined as: leading_bjet['pt']
  - upstream chain: leading_bjet -> helper_get_leading(selected_bjets)
  - collection definition: pT of leading b-jet
  - structure: single-constituent

* subleading_bjet_pt
  - computed/defined as: subleading_bjet['pt']
  - upstream chain: subleading_bjet -> helper_get_subleading(selected_bjets)
  - collection definition: pT of subleading b-jet
  - structure: single-constituent

* leading_bjet_eta
  - computed/defined as: leading_bjet['eta']
  - upstream chain: leading_bjet -> helper_get_leading(selected_bjets)
  - collection definition: η of leading b-jet
  - structure: single-constituent
